Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began.
